summary: One-frame event of esv::relation::RelationSystem: a summon got its faction set (from its owner). Seen.py context: fights with summoners (mud mephits, woad, cloaker), spell casts (spells-5) and dialogues that summon.

fields.evidence: Toolkit ctor EoCServer.dll+0x23B250 SummonedFactionSetEventOneFrameComponent(ls::ID<ecs::EntityHandleTraits> const&) copies the 8-byte entity id to +0. Live: 9 instances, values like 0x7C3..0x19047 with high dword 0x00800001..0x02000013 (entity handles). Which entity (summon owner or faction source) is not established.

open_questions: Role of the entity (owner of the summon vs. the summon itself).
